svg.title: Perfboard layout, 1-roll
svg.text: perfboard layout: 120 × 80 mm fr4 dot board (tronic "vero board dot epoxy fr4 12x8cm"), component side
terminals on the two short ends, like the pcb. 1 grid square = 2.54 mm. heavy wires (red) go straight to t1, t2 and q1, not through the board.
enters here, solders to the hx711
e+ e− a− a+ on its left edge
fuse f1 (inline, on the lead) → t1; t1 + → t2 +, c1 +, mp1584 in+, fan + (t3, t4)
red 14 awg to t2; 22 awg to the rest
q1 source, c1 −, mp1584 in−/out−, supermini gnd, every module gnd
black 14 awg to q1; 22 awg to the rest
red/black 14 awg, as short as possible
hx711 vcc, t5 red, t6 3v3, both i2c headers, all pull-ups
r1 (500 Ω) → pc817 pin 1; pc817 pin 2 → gnd
pin 4 → r2 1 k → +12 v; pin 3 → q1 gate, r3 10 k → gnd
r4 / r5 500 Ω → q2 / q3 base; collector → t3− / t4−; d1 / d2 across each fan
r6 1 k → q4 base; q4 collector → buzzer −
t6 runout (r8 10 k to 3v3) / t6 motion through r9 1 k
t7 button, r10 10 k to 3v3; t7 other side → gnd
scl / sda to both i2c headers, r11 / r12 4.7 k to 3v3
